source_checks.source: Auffinger, Damron and Hanson, 50 years of first passage percolation, arXiv:1511.03262v2, Section 3.1, Question 13
source_checks.exact_quote: Show that for any d >= 2, under suitable conditions on F, chi < 1/2. If d = 2, show that chi = 1/3.
source_checks.finding: This is the main source question underlying the ranking title. Question 15 separately asks for chi>0 in a suitable dimension. The authors explicitly say the meaning of variance asymptotic and 'suitable conditions' are not settled in this broad formulation.

source_checks.source: Basu, Sidoravicius and Sly, Rotationally invariant first passage percolation: Breaking the n/log n variance barrier, arXiv:2604.01214v1, Theorem 1
source_checks.finding: For their planar Riemannian FPP class built from a smooth positive bounded isotropic finite-range dependent field with FKG, Var(X_n) <= n^(1-epsilon). This is a proved special model, not the nearest-neighbor iid lattice question or chi = 1/3.
The targeted local solved register has no FPP entry; the later FPP campaign says chi=1/3 remains untouched. Neither is a complete current-status check.

source_checks.source: Damron, Hanson, Houdre and Xu, arXiv:1810.08270v2, condition (1.2.1), Theorem 1, Remark 2
source_checks.finding: Full-lattice two-quantile fluctuation theorem is planar under F(0)<p_c and F(I)<oriented_p_c if I>0; it implies only logarithmic variance lower bound. The recalled card omits these conditions and wrongly says quantitative anti-concentration cannot imply a variance lower bound.

exact_statement: Source Question 13 is quoted above. Working precise lattice subproblem: on nearest-neighbor Z^2 with iid nondegenerate edge weights supported in [a,b], 0<a<b<infinity, prove that the limsup of log Var(T(0,ne1))/(2 log n) is strictly below 1/2; the chi=1/3 target would require the matching liminf and limsup to equal 1/3. This bounded-law specialization is ours, not a verbatim source theorem.
prior_attempt_status: The canonical math-brain attempt card records the n/log n exponent obstruction, author-checked only; CRUX section 9.5 conditionally reduces a lattice block-chaos route to (L1') conditional second moment, (L2') conditional increment kurtosis, and (L3) occupation count. Its section 9.2 formula was superseded, and chi=1/3 remains unproved there.
